key_insight: InfiniDream aims to create open-ended, photorealistic 3D worlds through procedural generation, moving beyond the limited asset variety of fixed factories and APIs.
problem_solved: VLM-generated code often produces simple 3D assets, while sophisticated procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided approaches also struggle to generate novel asset types beyond predefined tools.
method: Centers 3D world creation on procedural generation, which offers control, editability, and diversity.
Targets the limitations of VLM-guided generation constrained by predefined factories and APIs.
The supplied abstract is truncated, so the specific architecture, generation workflow, and evaluation cannot be verified.
impact: More flexible procedural generation could help practitioners produce diverse synthetic data and richer game environments with less manual asset development. The supplied excerpt does not establish achieved performance or quality.
visual_elements: Comparison diagram: fixed asset libraries versus open-ended procedural generation.
Conceptual workflow: AI guidance → procedural code → 3D assets → assembled world.

paper_title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
paper_authors: Yi-Chuan Huang, Hao-Jen Chien, Zheng-Hui Huang, Yu-Lun Liu, Kaipeng Zhang
